expires_today.title: Front End Web Development Bootcamp Bundle
expires_today.description: Get battle‑ready with web dev bootcamps.
expires_today.long_description:
Attention, cadettes—learn vital front‑end skills with the Front End Web Development Bootcamp Bundle. This battle‑tested 10‑course web development bundle from Treehouse prepares you for creative warfare, then tests your comprehension with a final tech‑degree exam and certification. Unlock instructor‑led video courses and go from cadet to major with lessons like Unit 1: Build a Personal Profile Page, Unit 2: Create a Mobile‑First Responsive Layout, and Unit 3: Build an Online Registration Form. Level up your skills with expert instruction—and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before September 18, 2027.

expires_today.title: Create Magic with Magix
expires_today.long_description: Breeze through photo, musical, or video projects with professional‑quality tools by MAGIX. Unlock advanced video editing software built with precision and speed in mind with MAGIX Video Pro X16, easy music production with loops from every genre and a drag‑and‑drop workflow from Music Maker 2025 Premium, customize slideshows that turn photos into dynamic stories with Photostory deluxe 2025, and so much more! Turn bold ideas into powerful stories with the Create Magic with MAGIX Bundle, and help support Children's Miracle Network with your purchase!

expires_today.title: ThreeDee Character Creator & 3D Asset Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Power your game’s potential with the ThreeDee Character Creator & 3D Asset Bundle! This amazing 3D character generator provides endless possibilities with fully rigged characters without any manual modeling. Perfect for artists, game developers, and anyone working on animations, this Blender-based system allows big‑time savings on time and effort. Armed with pre‑packaged libraries based on various ages, genders, and more, you’re ready to go immediately after downloading. Pay what you want for the ultimate character creation tool, and help support the World Wildlife Fund with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 9th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Make & Play Games in Godot
expires_today.long_description: Become a game dev mastermind when you harness the power of Godot! Learn how to create your own action RPG from the ground up with compelling combat mechanics, develop your own gravity-defying 3D platformer, build a 2D action-adventure game, and so much more with this curated bundle of approachable learning courses. Harness the power of Godot to bring your dream game to life, all for a price you choose. Plus pick up three games created with Godot: Buckshot Roulette, Windowkill, and The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition! Unlock the very best from GameDev.TV and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: POLY Game Dev Assets Collection #3
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Game developers, build your worlds easily and efficiently with our latest POLY Game Dev Asset Collection by Animpic Studio! Pay what you want for thousands of sharp assets from professional‑quality packs like POLY - Survival Subway, POLY - Survival Tower & Builder, and POLY - Fantasy House & Builder. These Unity and Unreal Engine‑compatible packs include FBX models, prefabs, materials, shaders, and multiple scene files. Create picture‑perfect polygon‑based assets without straining your team or wallet, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Batman Day Comics Bundle by DC Comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Own the night alongside the Caped Crusader with the Batman Day Comics Bundle 2026! Pay what you want for a catalog of modern classics by the biggest Batman artists and writers like Dan Watters, Scott Snyder, and Nick Dragotta. Read the Bat's action‑packed comics, including Batman: Dark Patterns, Batman Vol. 1–10 (2011–2016), and Absolute Batman Vol. 1: The Zoo. Bring your imagination and celebrate Batman Day on September 19th with the Dark Knight’s greatest adventures, and help support the BINC Foundation with your purchase!

Redeemed on GlobalComix. Keys expire. Please redeem and activate before October 10th, 2027. Titles are not available for download off of GlobalComix.

expires_tomorrow.title: IGN 30th Anniversary Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
September is a big month for many reasons—and this September is even bigger, because we’re celebrating IGN’s 30th Anniversary! That’s right, it’s been 30 years since the very first post on IGN’s website, and to kick off the festivities we’re bringing all of you a gift: A bundle of IGN favorites to enjoy all month long, and beyond! Wage war against the dragons of Tamriel and master the art of necromancy in The Elder Scrolls Online - Elsweyr! Brave the dark reefs and deep oceans and try your best not to get eaten in Subnautica! Protect reality itself from an unknown evil in post-apocalyptic horror game REMNANT II! There’s even more fun to be had in this fantastic bundle of fan-favorite games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support Child’s Play with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 9th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Garbage Dwellers
expires_tomorrow.description: One man's trash is another man’s treasure.
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
One man's trash is another man’s treasure. Good things happen in the bin—pay what you want for the Trash Dwellers Bundle of filthy fun games! Play A Plague Tale: Innocence and follow the grim tale of Amicia and her younger brother in a heart‑wrenching story of their darkest hours. Run ’n’ gun against the TechnoRat army alongside your tailed troops in the legendary Great Rat War of WAR RATS: The Rat em Up, or dive into a wholesome, cozy, trashy game with no shortage of rubbish in Trash Goblin. Save big on disgustingly good games and help support Canine Companions with your purchase!

The RAT PACK includes one (1) game key, selected at random from the four titles below by an automated randomization tool. You cannot choose which title you receive, and the title is revealed only after purchase:

  • Seize the Cheese
  • Dimensional Animals
  • The Lost Legends of Redwall: The Scout Anthology
  • Tanuki Sunset

Your Chances: Keys are stocked in near-equal quantities across the four titles; no title makes up more than approximately 27% of the total pool, and no title accounts for less than approximately 21%. Keys are drawn randomly from remaining stock, so the mix shifts as titles sell out. 
One (1) key per bundle purchased. Because there are only four titles, buying multiple bundles may result in a duplicate key purchase. A duplicate key cannot be redeemed a second time on the same Steam account, and Humble Support cannot exchange a key for a different title. Duplicate keys are not transferable.
All keys are Steam keys and require a Steam account.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 9th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Run It Back - Roguelikes Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Don’t be afraid to start over
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
There are few things as high-octane as playing a fantastic roguelike game with real consequences, and to celebrate a few of our favorites we’ve collected them all in this convenient roguelike games bundle! Mine for resources to build your home and fight monsters on an alien planet in Dome Keeper! Battle your way to the top in the adorably rabbit-themed co-op game Rabbit and Steel! Save the Twisted World from falling into chaos in the single-player deckbuilder Chrono Ark! And if you die, just start all over again! There’s even more fun to be had in this bundle of roguelikes, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Team Rubicon with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 2nd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: The Complete Claude and Anthropic Certification Bundle
expires_within_72h.long_description: Start an exciting career in AI with a little help from us and the pros at Mammoth Club with The Complete Claude and Anthropic Certification Bundle. Enjoy massive savings on first‑time Humble‑exclusive software courses designed to help you ace your certification exams with compelling courses and challenging practice tests like Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P) with Practice Exam and GPT-6 Astra Fundamentals: From First Prompt to Practical Applications. Learn how to design safe and steerable AI systems without the hassle of writing your own code, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!
